name: DOOM
description: Native DOOM source port for PS5 based on id Software's original linuxdoom-1.10. Features GPU rendering through AGC and VideoOut, DualSense controls with analog sticks and rumble, AudioOut sound, FM music synthesis, save support and a launcher for importing your own WAD files from local storage, a PC or phone browser, URLs, ZIP, 7Z and RAR archives.
author: lowbit
